title: Forza Horizon 6 Content Roadmap Revealed For Late 2026 & 2027
summary:
With a specific focus on January and February of next year.

Ready for some more news on Forza Horizon 6? The team at Playground Games has announced a content roadmap for the game today, pulling the curtain back on their plans for the end of 2026 and all of next year.

You can get loads of detail about all of this in the video up above, but in a nutshell, we're getting Series 8 "Horizon Holidays" and Series 9 "Legendary Explorers" before the year is out. Then, as we head into January and February, Series 10 will be based around "Exotics and Tuners", while other new additions include a permanent new radio station, absolutely loads of new Reward Cars, and various other bits and bobs.

title: Former Xbox First-Party Game 'Kiln' Gets A New Identity And Its Biggest Update Of All Time
summary:
There's even local multiplayer now!

When Double Fine released Kiln as an Xbox first-party title last year, it's fair to say a lot of the Xbox fanbase was baffled by it. As much as it was a good game (we gave it a 7/10 in our Pure Xbox review), it also shipped with just a singular, online-only mode that was bound to get old pretty quickly.

Double Fine ended up being let go by Xbox, turning Kiln from an Xbox first-party game into an independent game, and it received a brand-new update back in September, adding a new creative game mode along with various other features.

title: Asha Sharma Issues Statement On Xbox's 25th Anniversary And The Future Of Gaming
summary:
"Our largest studios will be able to pursue ambitions as far beyond today’s games".

We've been waiting all week for Xbox to acknowledge its 25th anniversary in a formal fashion, and Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has now issued a statement discussing the past, present and future of the brand to celebrate its birthday.

It's a pretty lengthy statement, and a lot of it is just about recapping the history of Xbox and Microsoft Gaming as a whole. Sharma talks about how things have come a long way since "Microsoft Adventure" in 1979, and then how Xbox was "impossible to miss" in 2001 while also revolutionising online play and being there for the launch of Halo.
